developer.description: Default developer: routine implementation and bounded fixes on Claude Code.

tester.description: Default tester: test design, running tests, and failure diagnosis on Claude Code.

reviewer.description: Default reviewer: ordinary correctness and maintainability review on Claude Code.

scout.description: Default scout: quick read-only exploration and file discovery on Claude Code.

deep-review.description: Pick for risky changes (security, data loss, concurrency, migrations) when the user wants a deeper review.

developer-codex.description: Pick only when the user explicitly asks for Codex; never as a fallback.

developer-pi.description: Pick only when the user explicitly asks for an OpenAI model through Pi; never as a fallback.
